description_en: Creates an account and directly adds it as a member
description_zh: 创建账号并直接添加成员
kebab_example: aliyun modelstudio add-organization-member --account-name '账号名称' --org-role-code ORG_MEMBER --spec-type standard --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddOrganizationMember

parameters.help_en: The display name. If this parameter is not empty, the name field of the account is updated synchronously
parameters.help_zh: 显示名称，若非空则同步更新账号的 name 字段
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The organization role code. Only ORG_ADMIN or ORG_MEMBER is allowed. Default value: ORG_MEMBER
parameters.help_zh: 组织角色编码，只允许 ORG_ADMIN 或 ORG_MEMBER，默认 ORG_MEMBER
parameters.name: org_role_code

parameters.help_en:
The seat specification. Valid values:

- standard: standard seat.
- pro: premium seat.
- max: exclusive seat
parameters.help_zh:
席位规格
- standard - 标准席位
- pro - 高级席位
- max - 尊享席位
parameters.name: spec_type
